title: O Mapa Sob o Vidro
content_md:
## O Mapa Sob o Vidro

Lia Arcos nunca confiava em uma rua que permanecia no mesmo lugar por tempo demais.
summary: Lia receives a living map under glass and sees her missing brother's name fade from the ink.
canon_changes: Living maps can erase names from visible ink.

character_states.name: Lia Arcos
character_states.state: frightened but determined to investigate the erased district

world_updates: Maps move more clearly when sealed under glass.
timeline_updates: Chapter 1 begins on the night Lia receives the illegal map.
new_threads: Who sent the map to Lia?
Why is her brother's name vanishing?
callbacks: The phrase about streets staying in place can return when the city changes.
continuity_risks: Define whether erased names erase memories or only written records.
style_notes: Close third, sensory, tense, restrained lyricism.
